title: Deccan Canopy Haven
sensory: Feel the warmth of the sun on your skin as you sit beneath the dappled light. Listen to the symphony of calls from birds nesting in the canopy, and notice the rustling of leaves as the wind shifts through the branches.  Take a moment to observe the intricate patterns of the leaves and their textures.
brain_prompt: Imagine yourself as a bird, perched high in the tree canopy. What does the air feel like? How do the shadows dance on the leaves?  What sounds are most prominent around you?
